shortDescription: Brazilian conglomerate Cosan BMFBOVESPA:CSAN3 said on Tuesday it had engaged in exclusive negotiations with potential investors interested in the firm's equity interest in rail freight unit Rumo BMFBOVESPA:RAIL3, adding no agreement was reached.Cosan said in a securities filing that the exclusivity…

children: said on Tuesday it had engaged in exclusive negotiations with potential investors interested in the firm's equity interest in rail freight unit Rumo

Cosan said in a securities filing that the exclusivity period for talks has ended, without naming the potential investors. The firm continues to evaluate alternatives across all of its assets to optimize its capital structure, it added.
